$comment: Identity registry of the REAL documents used as prompt exemplars. Lint L9: an extraction whose context identity differs from an exemplar's but whose output contains that exemplar's distinctive values is parroting -> retry/quarantine. These source documents are excluded from gold-gate aggregates (smoke-only). A pytest should re-derive this file from the exemplar .md files and fail on drift. CURATION RULE (must be enforced before lint L9 is implemented): distinctive_strings/distinctive_numbers may hold only values actually discriminative of the exemplar (exemplar-specific dates, verbatim policy sentences, unusual labels, point totals unlikely elsewhere). Universal enum values (high/medium/low, exam/quiz/homework), common small integers (counts like 3 or 12), and round percentages (10/20/25) must NOT be listed - they occur in most legitimate extractions and would make L9 flag everything.
